about: Composite band presets (exotic objects design 6A, XO17): presentation data, not physics. Each preset is a list of layers, a band id from the sheet's Bands table and the colour it is laid in. Visible keeps its natural colours. A pack or Orac adds more with withCompositePresets(). The starting colours follow observatory habit: X-ray violet, ultraviolet blue, infrared red, radio orange.

presets.name: Observatory
presets.why: As observatory press pictures are made: hot gas, starlight, warm dust and radio in one frame

presets.name: Hot and cold
presets.why: The hottest and the coolest things in view at once

presets.name: Radio over visible
presets.why: Jets, lobes and belts glowing over what the eye sees
